snapshot.text: Mainly public system financed through compulsory insurance and the state budget, run by the Ministry of Health and Social Welfare. Cancer care, hospital restructuring and medicines funding top the 2026 agenda.

minister.name: Evis Sala
minister.role: Minister of Health and Social Welfare

priorities.title: Oncology reform
priorities.text: A National Cancer Institute and national tumour network, with chemotherapy capacity doubled at the university hospital centre.

priorities.title: National Hospital Plan
priorities.text: Stronger regional hospitals with more managerial autonomy, and wider screening and vaccination.

priorities.title: One digital system for hospitals
priorities.text: Hospitals are to be linked through one digital system.
